message:
As a grandparent, I cherish the moments when my grandkids come over, especially when we turn a little learning into a cozy event. I've found this fantastic resource that helps teach kids about preparedness in a fun and engaging way. We can gather around the table, read through the activities, and even create our own emergency plans together. It’s a wonderful way to bond and have those important conversations without any stress. 

Who knew that being ready for anything could feel so warm and nurturing?
